name: Shiphrah
title: Brave Hebrew Midwife
summary: Shiphrah was one of two Hebrew midwives who feared God and refused to obey Pharaoh's command to kill all newborn Hebrew boys. Her courageous disobedience toward Pharaoh helped preserve the Israelite people, and God blessed her for her faithfulness.

keyEvents.title: Pharaoh's Command to Kill Male Infants
keyEvents.description: Pharaoh ordered the Hebrew midwives Shiphrah and Puah to kill every male child born to Hebrew women.

keyEvents.title: Shiphrah Refuses to Obey Pharaoh
keyEvents.description: Shiphrah and Puah feared God and did not obey Pharaoh's command. They let the boys live, which was an act of courageous resistance.

keyEvents.title: The Midwives' Defense Before Pharaoh
keyEvents.description: When Pharaoh confronted the midwives, they explained that Hebrew women were so vigorous that they gave birth before the midwives could arrive.

keyEvents.title: God's Blessing on the Midwives
keyEvents.description: Because the midwives feared God, he dealt well with them. The people became numerous and powerful, and God gave the midwives families of their own.

keyEvents.title: Israel's growth despite oppression
keyEvents.description: Despite Pharaoh's attempts at genocide, the Israelite people continued to grow in number, partly thanks to the courageous efforts of Shiphrah and Puah.
